notes: RGSS runtimes are Windows-only. Ruby 1.9.2 is a PREFILL, not a pin: mkxp-z deliberately declares vxace against both 1.9.2 and 3.1.3, and the config editor keeps runtimeRequirements user-editable so either branch stays selectable. The Game.ini Library line is the engine declaring its own RGSS build; the .rgss3a check tolerates renamed archives (real install: Game.rgss3a.old).

saves.source: Checked in a shipped RGSS3 game's Data/Scripts.rvdata2: DataManager.make_filename is sprintf("Save%02d.rvdata2") (stock), and the same game's own script moves them to Save/Save%02d.rvdata2; mkxp-z src/config.cpp:456-459 names the .rvdata2 extension
